editorial.blurb: Pochos brings vibrant Mexican-American comfort food to the table with serious care and skill, from their legendary chilaquiles to creative brunch dishes that genuinely deliver.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Chilaquiles in-person at brunch (avoid delivery — they lose their integrity) and ask the chef to cook the steak to their liking; hit up around 1pm on Saturday for no wait, and don't miss the $5 hibiscus mimosa Monday special.
